tokens.name: ground-shop
tokens.usage: Blush page background for every shopper screen.

tokens.name: ground-admin
tokens.usage: Page background for the admin dashboard. Calmer than the shop blush.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cream cards on the shop: product cards, bag items, info boxes, bottom bars, search field.

tokens.name: surface-white
tokens.usage: Admin panels and all form field fills.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Photo placeholder ground and the track of the Everyday/Premium switch. Every product photo sits on this colour.

tokens.name: surface-petal
tokens.usage: Homepage hero, free-delivery nudge, product page gallery ground.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Admin table headers, order board columns, neutral chips.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Espresso. Main shop text, primary buttons, the Premium ground, admin sidebar.

tokens.name: ink-admin
tokens.usage: Main text on admin screens.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: helper lines, labels, delivery details. 6:1 or better on every ground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Third-level text: unselected nav items, notes, counts. 5.4:1 on ground-shop; never on surface-petal below 15px.

tokens.name: ink-on-dark
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ink (espresso) grounds.

tokens.name: accent-rose
tokens.usage: Deep rose. Links, 'Only X left', bag count dot, sale badge fill (with white text), admin text links. 5.5:1 on surface-card.

tokens.name: accent-rose-gold
tokens.usage: Decoration only: filled tracker beads, chart highlights, cover blocks. White text on it is 3.8:1, so never use it behind small text.

tokens.name: accent-rose-light
tokens.usage: Text and badges on espresso: Premium labels, 'Complete the look' eyebrow. 9:1 on ink.

tokens.name: line-shop
tokens.usage: Borders on shop chips, outline buttons, size buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: line-admin
tokens.usage: Admin panel borders and table row dividers.

tokens.name: line-field
tokens.usage: Admin input and secondary button borders.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Paid, Live, Visible, 'Yes' on sale. Text or fill with white.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background of success pills.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Text in warning pills: Scheduled, Waiting, late orders.

tokens.name: warning-edge
tokens.usage: Outline on late order cards and low-stock fields; warning dots.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of warning rows and pills.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Sold out, payment saved without an order, remove actions.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of danger rows.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Homepage hero headline, set in capitals.

styles.name: title-page
styles.usage: Product name, screen titles on the shop.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Placeholder logo, in capitals, until the real logo arrives.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Soft ribbed joggers with a high, wide waistband.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text, order numbers.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices on cards and in lists. Always tabular figures.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Card, bank transfer or USSD on Paystack's secure page.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small capital labels above headings and on badges.

styles.name: admin-title
styles.usage: Admin screen titles. Admin uses Jost only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, size buttons and small items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid; inner padding of small cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side gutter on every phone screen; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on shop screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Admin page padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Admin small buttons, thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Admin inputs and buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Shop inputs, size buttons, small photo tiles.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Admin panels and cards.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Shop product cards, bag items, info boxes.

tokens.name: radius-hero
tokens.usage: Homepage hero, dark feature blocks, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: All shop buttons, chips, badges, the tier switch, colour swatches.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: The selected half of a switch or tab. The only shadow in the system.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target: icon buttons, swatches, size buttons.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Primary shop buttons and the sticky Add to bag bar.

tokens.name: field-height
tokens.usage: Shop form fields. Admin fields are 42px.

tokens.name: phone-width
tokens.usage: Width every shop screen is designed at first.
